quote: I tapped Book and the fare jumped 12 AED. I thought the number on the map was the price.
It said 'Busy area' but not why my ride costs more. I assumed Careem was just charging extra.
The estimate said 28 SAR. The trip ended at 36. I screenshot everything now.
Promo showed 20% off, then the fare barely moved. I don't know what the promo actually applied to.
Cash still works, but I only saw the total after the captain arrived. Too late to change my mind.
The spinner just says Finding a captain. After 40 seconds I thought the app froze.
I wanted to see nearby cars on the map while it searched. Blank map made me anxious.
I cancelled after 2 minutes and got a fee warning that wasn't there when I first booked.
I wanted to share my trip with my brother before a captain accepted. The button was greyed out.
It flipped from 8 min away to 3 min with no explanation. I didn't trust the ETA after that.
The pin snapped to the mall entrance across the street. I couldn't nudge it onto my side.
Search found the street but not my society gate. I had to drop a pin and hope.
Captain called because pickup was behind the building. Editing the pin mid-wait restarted matching.
Home is saved, but Work keeps resetting to a random street. I retype it every morning.
I found Add stop only after booking. I wanted to add the pharmacy before confirming.
I changed drop-off in-trip and the fare preview disappeared. I confirmed blind.
Food, Pay, and Boxes sit above Ride. I just want a car. Too many choices for a 7am commute.
I like seeing everything in one place, but Ride should stay one tap from open.
I switched to Arabic and the Ride card title stayed in English. Felt unfinished.
Promos take half the home screen. I had to scroll to find Where to.
Card failed with 'Try again'. No reason. I didn't know if I was charged.
Wallet deducted twice. The receipt still said pending. I opened the bank app to check.
Cash vs card is buried under a tiny chevron. I booked on card by accident.
Promo field appears after payment method. I entered the code too late and it vanished.
Map recentered on me, not the captain. I kept losing the car.
Call captain is behind a menu. In a rush I couldn't find it.
Share trip needs two taps and a contact picker. I wanted one tap to a trusted person.
Arriving now disappeared, then the captain was already outside. No knock or call.
I couldn't tell if Women preferred was on until after matching. The toggle is easy to miss.
Family sharing asked for contacts permission again. I abandoned it in the back seat.
Report is after the trip ends. I wanted to flag something while still in the car.
Toll + waiting + adjustment. I needed a plain-language line for each, not codes.
I couldn't find Help from the receipt. I had to leave the trip history entirely.
I got Captain arriving and Captain delayed in the same minute. Which one is true?
Trip updates are useful. Promo pushes at 11pm are not.
Phone OTP took 90 seconds. The screen told me to wait 30. I requested a new code too early.
First-run asked for location permission after I typed a drop-off. The map then wiped my text.
Photo, plate, and rating are clear. I just wish the plate was larger at night.
Two white Camrys arrived. Plate was in a small grey type. I almost got in the wrong car.
Urdu keyboard suggestions didn't match the map results. English search worked better, which is backwards for me.
Recents mixed food orders with ride drop-offs. I picked the restaurant address by mistake.
Fee appears only on the confirm sheet. I would have waited 30 more seconds if I knew.
Free cancel window is not shown on the matching screen. I learned it by getting charged.
Add money jumped to a web view. I thought I left the app and closed it.
Refund said 2-5 days. No progress. I submitted a second ticket.
Last destination as a chip is perfect. I book home in one tap most nights.
GO vs Comfort vs Plus. I don't know what I get for the extra 8 SAR besides a nicer car.
Numbers stayed Western, but the fare chip flipped to the wrong side in Arabic. I kept tapping the map.
